## D. Cost beyond LLM tokens: tool executions per fact and the break-even weight w

Tool executions = deterministic tool executions of the check (replayed evidence queries, hashed files, certificate calls, files diffed) + tool calls of the re-derivations the policy triggered (recorded traces). Certificate construction tool calls are not counted (favours the certificates). Total cost(w) = LLM tokens + w × tool executions; w* = break-even weight at which ESM and the baseline cost the same; ESM is cheaper for w < w* when it executes more tools than the baseline.
